newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SAYS COMMITTED TO DOUBLE-DIGIT GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SAYS COMMITTED TO DOUBLE-DIGIT GROWTH.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Friday it was committed to achieving double-digit profit growth over the next few years.
"We have committed ourselves to a profit growth which should be called a double-digit profit growth over the next few years," chairman Cor Boonstra told the annual shareholders' meeting.
Boonstra, addressing his first shareholders' meeting since taking over as chairman late last year, said Philips would publish details of its long-term strategy later this year.
"At the end of this year we will be ready to face the outside world with a policy which is going to guide us for quite some time," he said.
